exposure: abdominal striae gravidarum (assessed using the Davey scoring system)
intraabdominal adhesions (assessed using the modified Nair scoring system)
cohort: 247 pregnant women at ≥ 37 weeks of gestation admitted to the labor unit for delivery, all of whom had undergone at least one previous cesarean section
finding: There was a statistically significant inverse relationship between the severity of abdominal striae gravidarum and the severity of intraabdominal adhesions.
